title: Mathematics Practice Test 1 - Mathematics - Unit Conversion
subject: Mathematics

questions.q:
A boat is traveling at a speed of 30 miles per hour. What is the boat's speed in feet per second?
(Note: 1 mile = 5,280 feet)
questions.explain: Convert miles per hour to feet per second using dimensional analysis: $(30 \text{ miles} / 1 \text{ hour}) \times (5280 \text{ feet} / 1 \text{ mile}) \times (1 \text{ hour} / 3600 \text{ seconds}) = (30 \times 5280) / 3600 = 44 \text{ feet per second}$.
